_note: The rail's key-figure cards. The content-first source format has no rail, so these were drafted 2026-09-12 from the ENGLISH source for Leon's review, and each number and each sentence on a card is taken verbatim from that article; only the short 'k' labels are new.

cards.p: Your budget buys a certain number of clicks per day. Dividing that budget across ten campaigns does not buy more clicks.
The account buys the same 25 clicks per day in both cases. Across ten campaigns each keyword takes about 9 days to reach a decision; across four it takes about 4 days.
They are your campaigns, bidding against each other, and the effect is usually a higher cost per click for the same sale.
Treat it as a promotion, not a starting structure. A keyword earns its own campaign by converting.
